Based on the image provided:

1)  **Composer/Message Input:** There is **no** composer or message input field visible at the bottom of the main surface. The bottom area displays a status notification banner instead.
2)  **Slash-command dropdown/menu:** **No**, a slash-command dropdown or menu is not visible in the image.
3)  **Other changes vs a plain empty main surface:**
    *   The main surface is populated with the **"Appearance" settings page**, including theme selection options (System, Light, Dark), code preview blocks, and color configuration fields (Accent, Background, Foreground).
    *   A **toast notification banner** is overlaid at the very bottom center of the window containing the text: **"Connection lost. Reconnecting..."** with a **"Dismiss"** button on the right side.
